Split caching.py: key strategies to cache_keys, store caching to store_caching (#70)

- The key-strategy protocol for cache_this (KeyStrategy, ExplicitKey,
  ApplyToMethodName, InstanceProp, ApplyToInstance, FromMethodArgs,
  CompositeKey and the key resolvers) moves to dol/cache_keys.py.
- The store caching layers (cache_vals, mk_sourced_store, store_cached,
  mk_write_cached_store, WriteBackChainMap, flush_on_exit, ...) move to
  dol/store_caching.py.
- dol.caching keeps cache_this and its descriptors, and re-exports every moved
  name; the back-compat snapshot test covers it.

No behaviour change.
